constraints: Passing 'Object current' (or omitting selector) must be called in the context of a form object method/submethod, otherwise it returns an empty string.
Passing 'Object with focus' returns the name of the object currently holding focus in the form.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the name of the form object designated by selector: the calling object itself (default, 'Object current') or the object currently holding focus ('Object with focus').

discriminatedBy.rule: selector (a 'Form Objects (Access)' theme constant) picks between 'Object current'/omitted (the calling object) and 'Object with focus' (the focused object); no other selector values are documented for this command.
